classifiedDifferences.detail: Foundry stores Metamagic choices as ItemChoice entries pointing to separate feat-like documents; Oracle stores the same ten options as canonical feature entities in a scalable/replacable EntityCollection.

Foundry models Draconic Spells as separate ItemGrant advancements at spell-unlock levels 3/5/7/9; Oracle keeps Draconic Spells as one canonical subclass feature whose spell grants carry minimumClassLevel values.
Foundry expresses several class grants through Advancement documents; Oracle keeps canonical features separate and references them from 20 level advancement rows.
